description: Arnseth and Krange argue, building on Vygotsky and Wertsch, that \"the unit of analysis needs to be a functional system incorporating tools.\" This stance opens up understanding of the multiplicity of activities, in which collaboration between students and computational tools can take multiple paths,
title: Functional system incorporating tools as the unit of analysis for CSCL microanalysis

description: To answer criticisms that social-cognitive models are unfalsifiable, the authors classify each of the model's 23 hypotheses as fundamental or peripheral.
title: Fundamental-versus-peripheral hypothesis taxonomy for model replication and falsification

description: The digest's recommendation set for teachers who plan similar projects: \"the following minimal conditions are suggested\" — theoretical teacher preparation, believing households contain abundant social and intellectual resources; home visits as participant-observers entering as learners; teacher labs
title: Funds of Knowledge

description: The Future Technology Workshop (FTW) is a structured participatory method in which participants with everyday knowledge of a domain envision and design interactions between current and future technology and activity.
title: Future Technology Workshop (FTW) method
